note: A short list, not a measurement — included for Task 10 completeness.

items.title: More races
items.detail: Fit/evaluate across multiple Grands Prix so results generalise beyond one circuit's tyre/fuel/safety-car regime.

items.title: Multi-session Task 4/5
items.detail: Extend data engineering and feature selection to practice/qualifying sessions, not race-only.

items.title: QAOA / quantum optimisation vs. the A* baseline
items.detail: The project already has a parameter-matched VQC/VQR/quantum-kernel comparison (Extension task); a QAOA formulation of the pit-stop scheduling problem itself, compared against A*'s plan cost, is the natural next step.

items.title: Live FastF1 timing feed
items.detail: Replace the single-snapshot race-state form with a live timing subscription so laps_remaining, fuel and position stop being user-entered approximations.
